text:
deploy-bot: deploy window open — initiating canary. Targets: API=v2.4.1, Runtime=3.14 (kernel batching), Console=1.9, Router=2.7. Canary plan: 5% EU first, then 20% global if green. /assign @Alice @Ben

Alice: noted. runtime change includes new batching kernel, expecting better throughput but unknown interaction with kv-cache eviction.

Ben: Router team reported intermittent 50ms p99 spikes in eu-west during long-sequence tests earlier. Might affect canary.

Carla: Console dashboards already showing a small spike in panel-render times when we hit router staging. Could be metric aggregator backpressure.

Dinesh: suggestion: pin router to 2.7-stable instead of the new 2.7-beta. Also propose shifting canary to US-first to reduce EU blast radius.

Elaine: note for release notes: kernel batching + kv-eviction tweak — add rollback instructions and known impact to dashboards.

deploy-bot: pausing canary — hold at 0% due to router lag in EU :warning:. Extending window +30m. @Alice confirm runtime fallback binary present and healthchecks.

Alice: verified. fallback binary uploaded: s3://redwood/dist/runtime/3.14-fallback.tar.gz. Staging healthchecks pass (startup + perf smoke).

Ben: compatibility matrix: console 1.9 expects router >=2.7.0. If we pin router down too far console features may disable. We can decouple: proceed API+runtime, delay console/router wave.

Carla: +1 to decouple. Less cross-service churn. Also avoids metric churn on dashboard consumers.

Dinesh: agree. operational ask: ops team please set rollout order to [API, Runtime] now; Router/Console -> wave 2.

Ops-guard: got it. changing rollout order. Setting router to "deferred" and will keep it on 2.6.12 for this window.

deploy-bot: updating plan: Canary -> 1% US only for API+Runtime. Router/Console deferred to follow-up wave. New canary window 15m. Monitoring hooks: per-route p99, kv_evictions, runtime-fallback-events.

Elaine: rollback criteria proposal: if route p99 > 300ms for 10m OR error rate > 1% for 5m -> immediate pause + rollback runtime to 3.13. Also if kv_evictions spike > 10/min for 5m.

Alice: runtime rollback tested: `deploy rollback --service runtime --version 3.13 --reason "post-canary degradation"` works, hot path validated.

Ben: starting 1% US canary now. tagging monitors: @pageready, @slo-alerts.

Carla: watch console metrics for panel_render_time and metric_ingest_lag. I have a quick dashboard pinned: /dashboards/canary/runtime-api-quick.

deploy-bot: canary at 1% US. Will report back at +5m and +15m.

(5m) Ben: no errors, p95 steady, p99 ~180ms on canary routes. kv_evictions stable.

(10m) Alice: runtime telemetry: kernel batching CPU usage +8% but within limit, no fallback triggers.

(14m) Carla: console panels show small blip at +12m but recovered. metric_ingest_lag peaked 2s for 3m. not breach.

(15m) Ben: canary green for API+Runtime. Promoting to 20% global.

Elaine: drafting release-note snippet: 
- API v2.4.1: minor stability fixes.
- Runtime 3.14: kernel batching optimization (rolled out to API-only wave). Fallback to 3.13 available.
- Router & Console: deferred to next wave to avoid cross-service churn.
Known issues: temporary dashboard blips during rollout; watch kv_evictions.

Dinesh: scheduling follow-up wave for router+console next Tuesday maintenance window. I'll own the pin/compat testing.

deploy-bot: rollout progressed: API+Runtime at 20% global, Router/Console deferred. Closing this thread — follow-up scheduled by Dinesh. :thumbsup:

Elaine: will publish release notes after copy review. Thanks all. :tada:
